english.title: Fail to give name and address and produce test certificate to a constable after accident / suspected offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road namely, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to give your name and address and to produce for examination a test certificate issued in respect of the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drive a motor vehicle on a road or
suspected of being the driver
at time of accident / committing an offence
in relation to motor vehicle
fail to give to a constable your name and address
and to produce test certificate in respect of the vehicle

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording relates to motor vehicles other than invalid carriages.
(ii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See sections 165(2)(c) for requirements re production of goods vehicle plating certificate and test certificate
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was

(A)_[the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) when an accident occurred owing its presence]_
(C)_[suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..).

The defendant failed to give

(D)_[his name and address]_
(E)_[her name and address]_

to a police constable when requested to do so and failed to produce for examination a test certificate in respect of the vehicle, when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Methu rhoi enw a chyfeiriad a chyflwyno tystysgrif prawf i gwnstabl ar ôl damwain / trosedd honedig
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau'n unigolyn

(A)_[yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY MOTOR VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod yn gyrru cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY MOTOR VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar adeg pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[yr oedd gan gwnstabl achos rhesymol dros gredu eich bod wedi cyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio cerbyd modur, sef **(..SPECIFY MOTOR VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar ffordd, sef, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), pan gawsoch eich cyfarwyddo i wneud hynny gan gwnstabl, bu i chi fethu rhoi eich enw a'ch cyfeiriad na chyflwyno tystysgrif prawf i'w harchwilio yng nghyswllt y cerbyd
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) roedd y diffynnydd

(A)_[yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[yn cael ei amau o yrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) pan ddigwyddodd damwain oherwydd ei bresenoldeb]_
(C)_[yn cael ei amau o gyflawni trosedd yng nghyswllt defnyddio **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..).

Methodd y diffynnydd roi

(A)_[ei enw a'i gyfeiriad]_
(B)_[ei henw a'i chyfeiriad]_

i gwnstabl yr heddlu pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny a methu cyflwyno tystysgrif prawf yng nghyswllt y cerbyd i'w harchwilio, pan ofynnwyd iddo/iddi wneud hynny, naill ai ar y pryd neu o fewn saith niwrnod wedi hynny.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 165(3) Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.
